newsitem.title: INDIA: India Infosys bonus to boost Birla Mutual.
newsitem.headline: India Infosys bonus to boost Birla Mutual.

text.p: A bonus issue of shares planned by software firm Infosys Technologies Ltd will boost Birla Advantage Fund, the mutual fund of Birla Capital International AMC Ltd, its chief executive officer said on Friday.

"It is the number one stock in Birla Advantage Fund," Birla Capital's chief executive officer Ramamoorthy Ganesh told Reuters. Birla Capital is a joint venture of India's Aditya Birla Group and U.S. fund manager Capital International.
Earlier on Friday, Infosys said its board will meet on April 8 to finalise results for 1996/97 (April-March) and to discuss a bonus issue of shares.
According to data released by Birla Mutual Fund, its single largest investment in its portfolio on December 31 -- 5.18 billion rupees -- was in 67,700 shares of Infosys.
Shares of Infosys jumped 112 rupees or 10 percent to 1,242 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday after the company said its board would consider a bonus issue of shares.
